subject: The meeting you forgot had 3 action items
preview_text: Before Smart Notes, I was that person. Now? Embarrassingly better. See the difference.
body_paragraphs: Remember that meeting last Tuesday at 3PM? The one where you nodded along, took a few scribbles, and walked out feeling confident? Two hours later, you couldn't recall the key deadline. I've been there—wasting 30 minutes digging through mental fog, only to miss the one action item that mattered.

Without this app, it's chaos: notes scattered across sticky pads, voice memos you never transcribe, and that sinking feeling when your team asks for a recap. With Smart Notes, it's the opposite. You tap one button, the AI captures every word, and within minutes you have a structured summary with action items. The contrast is embarrassing—in a good way. You stop being the person who forgets and start being the one who has answers ready.

Here's where it gets real: our language-aware transcription and summary output means even if the meeting switched between English and Spanish, you get clean, searchable text. And the shareable notes? Your team thanks you. No more chasing down follow-ups.

Open the app now and record your next conversation—even a 5-minute call. See how it feels to walk away with clarity. P.S. Users who create their first summary on day one return far more consistently. Yours is waiting.
